LanguageData.WFL_UX_AccountingHelp: Ownership is what each account holds. Available silver is the physically backed portion it can spend now. Debts are separate obligations.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_PhysicalClaims: All accounts own {0} silver. Physical silver across colony maps, pockets and caravans: {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_NoTreasuryZone: No Treasury Zone on this map. Accounts and payroll already work without one.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_ZoneHelpButton: How to designate a Treasury Zone
LanguageData.WFL_UX_ZoneHelp: Open Architect > Zone > Treasury Zone and paint the treasury area. A working treasury office needs a suitable room with a table, a seat and storage. The zone enables office work; balances and payroll do not require it. Select the zone to inspect its missing requirements.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_IncomePolicy: Share of future income kept by the community
LanguageData.WFL_UX_IncomeScope: Applies to future quest rewards and shared profit from community-owned trade goods. Trade cost recovery and proceeds belonging to an owner follow their existing rules. Existing balances, earned wages and debts are unchanged.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_PolicyApplied: The community income share has been updated for future transactions.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_TrackingHelp: Track valuable materials as stored assets. Tracking creates no spendable silver. Stopping tracking leaves every physical item untouched.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_AssetMap: Loose and stored stacks on {0}. Inventories and caravans are excluded from this asset list.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_NoAssetsToAdd: No additional valuable materials are available to track.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_StartingBalance: Starting treasury balance recorded: {0} silver already in the colony.
LanguageData.wils.treasury_earn_help: Earn career experience through treasury office work and tax collection duties.
LanguageData.wils.treasury.treasurer_help: Manages treasury office business. Financial settlement and payroll do not require an office visit.
LanguageData.wils.treasury.taxcollector_help: Carries out tax collection duties after earning the required qualification.
LanguageData.WFL_UX_UnclaimedSilver: Previously unallocated silver recorded in the treasury.
